tasks.task: Create per-stage tracing for auth, event append, projection, copy lookup, serialization and transport.

tasks.task: Run controlled profiler with 1, 10, 50 and 100 concurrent local clients.
tasks.acceptance: Show CPU, lock wait, I/O, allocation and p50/p95/p99 per scenario
limitations: Three trials per concurrency level on one Windows 8-CPU host are local operational evidence, not a production capacity guarantee
Python allocation peaks use a separate tracemalloc pass to avoid distorting latency and throughput
OS process I/O counters can omit cached writes and RSS is sampled every 10 ms

tasks.task: Remove dominant contention by measurement with before/after regression proof.
tasks.acceptance: On identical hardware and seeds, optimization improves target latency without invariant regression
limitations: One local Windows 8-CPU host; three trials per concurrency level and normal-approximation confidence intervals are operational evidence, not a general capacity guarantee.
The optimization reduces latency modestly at measured concurrency; it does not remove the remaining process-local lock queue.
The 100-client after run omits the separate tracemalloc pass; latency and throughput are untraced.

tasks.task: Validate SQLite busy timeout, WAL mode, checkpoint strategy and transaction sizes.
tasks.acceptance: Stress run sustains no silent lost write or unbounded busy retry across 50 processes
limitations: One local Windows 8-CPU host with SQLite 3.49.1; this is not a multi-host capacity guarantee.
The default 5-second timeout produced explicit database-is-locked failures under the synchronized 50-process workload; the tested configuration required busy_timeout_ms=30000.
At 30 seconds, the longest measured transaction took 20.2 seconds; callers must accept potentially long waits under contention.

tasks.task: Build bounded paginated query/scan benchmarks at 1k, 10k and 100k memories.
tasks.acceptance: Complexity trend and memory budget are plotted; failing scale regimes recorded honestly
limitations: Synthetic one-MemoryCreated-event-per-memory fixture on one local Windows host with a warm SQLite cache; not an external production corpus or remote-storage benchmark.

This benchmark covers bounded EventLog keyset scans; the operator list path still materializes and sorts the complete in-memory projection before applying its output limit, and is flagged for separate work.

tasks.task: Simulate three logical hosts using distinct localhost processes and stores.
tasks.acceptance: Corrections converge after partitions heal with all acknowledgements accounted for; not called physical-host proof

Partition is modeled by stopping a server process; no packet-loss, bandwidth, clock-skew, or physical multi-host properties are claimed.

tasks.task: Test reordered, duplicated, delayed and permanently dropped federation messages.
tasks.acceptance: Replay and idempotency preserve state; dead-letter and repair outcomes are observable

tasks.task: Inject clock skew and stale or forged signed freshness leases.

tasks.task: Create long-duration deterministic soak with crash/restart cycles and strict disk/resource ceilings.

tasks.task: Add risk-sensitive evidence policies for read, summarize, recommend and externally consequential execute.

limitations: Summarize and recommend are typed evidence-use modes on recall/fetch; application-specific summarization and recommendation outputs still require their caller to preserve evidence references and warnings.

tasks.task: Build local 5, 10, 25, 50 and 100-agent scripted environments with identical tasks.
tasks.acceptance: All agent counts run from seed manifests and report task-family composition
limitations: This is a three-seed scripted-agent benchmark on one in-process store; it is not a real-model-agent or multi-host performance result.

tasks.task: Define matched local-only, pooled memory, blanket-retraction, Memory Fabric and oracle arms.
tasks.acceptance: Equal information exposure, runtime permissions and context budgets are enforced
limitations: The five arms are local synthetic policy implementations on one in-process store. They do not represent independently built third-party memory products or real-model reasoning.

tasks.task: Separate completion failures into retrieval, insufficient evidence, policy refusal, coordination and tool error.
tasks.acceptance: Every failure belongs to at least one audited class with source trace
limitations: Failure attribution covers this deterministic authorization benchmark; tool execution and real agent coordination are not exercised, so their observed counts are zero rather than evidence of general absence.

tasks.task: Measure outcomes across correction timing: before discovery, before planning and immediately before action.
tasks.acceptance: Report time-sensitive failures and prevent timing-dependent benchmark shortcuts
limitations: Three seeds and synthetic scripted agents on one local store. Event ordering is verified; elapsed times are not portable performance claims.

tasks.task: Add minority-agent and rare-source scenario families to catch majority consensus errors.

limitations: Three synthetic seeds and scripted policies. The result documents a constructed false-refusal case; it is not a population estimate for real agents.

tasks.task: Include real tradeoffs where safety prevents legitimate completion.
tasks.acceptance: Combined utility shows successful tasks, unsafe actions, wasted calls and delayed decisions
limitations: Three synthetic seeds and scripted policies. Authorization outcomes only; no external action is executed. Local latency is descriptive, not a performance claim.

tasks.task: Use local deterministic policy agents for continuous regression, not as substitutes for model results.
tasks.acceptance: Reports label these as simulation and explicitly state model-free limitations
limitations: The local R3 report family is explicitly synthetic_scripted and each report names its model-free limitations; this does not provide real-model evidence.

tasks.task: Implement a transport-agnostic agent adapter so external-model trials can be added later unchanged.
tasks.acceptance: Offline scripted adapter passes interface tests with all network/model calls disabled
limitations: The transport-neutral protocol and offline scripted adapter are implemented. No external-model adapter or model evaluation is claimed.

tasks.task: Set a research target >=80% task success on new held-out 50-agent scenarios, with safety unchanged.

Evidence: `benchmarks/paired_agent_bootstrap.py`, `benchmarks/stats.py`, `research/prereg/matched-agent-arms-v1.md`, `tests/test_paired_agent_bootstrap.py`, `research/results/r3-02-matched-agent-arms.json`, `research/results/r4-02-paired-agent-bootstrap.json` (DONE: paired 95% cluster-bootstrap effects reported against three matched baselines using 24 task cases and 1,200 agent attempts per arm. limitations: Reanalysis covers the registered synthetic 50-agent split (24 task cases, 1,200 attempts per arm); task clusters are exchangeable only within this fixture and do not support real-agent population claims.

tasks.task: Correct multi-family hypothesis comparisons or declare a small number of primary outcomes.
tasks.acceptance: Results distinguish primary, secondary and exploratory measurements without p-value fishing. Evidence: `benchmarks/paired_agent_bootstrap.py`, `benchmarks/threshold_registry.py`, `research/prereg/matched-agent-arms-v1.md`, `tests/test_paired_agent_bootstrap.py`, `research/results/r3-02-matched-agent-arms.json`, `research/results/r4-02-paired-agent-bootstrap.json` (DONE: one overall-success primary outcome; Holm-adjusted exact task-level sign tests for three non-oracle baseline contrasts; four task-family success rates and safety metrics as secondary; family-specific contrasts, latency and agent extrema exploratory. Since v1 outcomes predate the hierarchy amendment, inferential p-values are explicitly exploratory for this dataset; confirmatory claims require a future independently seeded run. Seven focused tests pass.)
limitations: One overall task-success primary outcome is contrasted against three non-oracle baselines with Holm-adjusted directional exact sign tests. tasks.task: Measure full installation size, startup time, storage growth and baseline CPU usage.

limitations: Measured on one Windows 11 host with Python 3.13.5; results are host- and environment-specific.

Idle CPU is a single 30-second sample; not a long-duration soak.

tasks.task: Exercise install/upgrade/rollback from existing supported baseline with persistent data.
tasks.acceptance: No loss of records, corrections, grants, tombstones or audit evidence in local simulation. Evidence: `tools/upgrade_rollback_smoke.py`, `research/results/p5-04-upgrade-rollback-smoke.json` (DONE: isolated v0.11.0 → v0.14.0 upgrade and rollback preserve the corrected v3 record, quarantined record, appended active record, tombstone history, exact-action GrantIssued event and verified 11-event chain; report binds baseline/candidate wheel hashes and clean driver commit. Host ActionPolicy configuration is separate from the persisted grant event; external effects remain outside this local simulation)
limitations: The v0.11.0 baseline uses host-configured ActionPolicy authorization; the drill proves a durable exact-action GrantIssued event created after upgrade survives rollback, not persistence of the host policy configuration.

The local simulation covers record creation, correction, quarantine/retraction, an exact-action grant event and audit-chain verification; it does not exercise every event type or external side effect.
